workarounds.note: BibTeX `and others` is read as an author named 'others' (parseNames in src/citations/bibtex.ts), so the Nature style prints '& others' instead of et al.; the works with more authors list their first six from Crossref, which the style's et-al-min of 6 turns into 'First, A. et al.'
an inline `::resource` with placement { position: 'here', span: 'page' } is set at the width of its column; Fig. 1 sits in a frameless page-span callout floated to the page foot (placement: 'bottom')

postext-citeproc: the bundled nature.csl prints the DOI twice for an article-journal with no volume yet (issuance prints https://doi.org/…, access prints doi:…); one string edit adds article-journal to the access macro's exclusion

a reference list cannot hold only the works first cited since the previous list (Nature's Methods references): :::bibliography{scope=chapter} lists every work the chapter cites; the article ends on one list
